title: CAS-07367 — RTÉ News: One O'Clock — RTÉ One
text:
Programme: RTÉ News: One O'Clock
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ One
Date broadcast or accessed: 16.03.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46L(1)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended. Code of Fairness, Objectivity & Impartiality in News and Current Affairs: Obligation 12.2.2
Short description: The complaint alleges that the report was not impartial as it aired the President’s St. Patrick’s Day address without providing a balanced counter-perspective, context regarding the constitutional limitations of the President’s role, or reflection on the traditional, religious, or historical significance of the patron saint.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
